instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sections.section_title:
Q.1 Choose the correct answer of the following (Any seven question
                    only):

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a common sheet metal material listed?
Which tool is primarily used to measure the thickness of sheet metal?
Which of the following is a product mentioned under product development?
Which joining method typically uses a filler metal and operates below 450°C?
Which type of sand is typically used for general molding purposes and has moisture content?
What is the function of a sprue pin in foundry work?
options: To create a passage for molten metal
To hold the pattern in place

questions.text: Which of the following is a method of filing used in fitting shops?
What is the main purpose of using a scriber in the fitting process?
options: To mark lines on metal surfaces

questions.text: Which of the following is a hot working process used in the smithy shop?
Which operation involves lengthening a workpiece by reducing its cross-section?
Explain the process of scribing in sheet metal work and its importance.
List any five tools used in sheet metal working and describe their functions briefly.
Describe the steps involved in manufacturing a funnel using sheet metal.

Explain the process of arc welding and list the safety precautions to be followed during the
                        operation.
List out different types of patterns used in foundry practice? Explain any three with advantages.

Explain the steps involved in sand casting, starting from pattern preparation to cleaning of the
                        final casting.
Describe various types of molding sands and mention their properties and uses.
List and describe the functions of any six tools used in pattern making and foundry practice.
Describe the various types of files and their uses in fitting practice.

Explain the safety precautions that must be observed in a fitting shop. Also explain the
                        difference between cross filing and draw filing.
Describe the various forging operations performed in a smithy shop.
Explain the differences between hot working and cold working processes with examples.

Discuss the process of seasoning of wood. What are the different methods of seasoning and why is
                        it important in carpentry work?
Describe the various tools used in carpentry and their specific functions.
